record.reason: The paper evaluates a multimodal auction-catalog extraction pipeline across cloud, institutional and local quantized-model deployments, reporting latency and accuracy. It finds CPU-only local execution impractical without constrained decoding. The contribution is an application-specific cultural-heritage workflow rather than a general LLM inference optimization.
record.title: Lot Machine: Multimodal Lot Extraction from Auction Catalogs
